title: bird doctor payload
description: Shape of the data payload returned by `bird doctor` under --output json. Mirrors the `DoctorReport` struct in src/doctor.rs: xurl status, per-app auth state with presence-only credential reporting, per-command accepted/credentialed scheme matrix, and entity-store health.

xurl.description: xurl binary availability and version detection (subprocess) or linked-crate stand-in (embedded).

path.description: Resolved filesystem path to the xurl binary (subprocess only).

version.description: Output of `xurl --version` (subprocess) or the embedded crate version (embedded).

auth.description: Per-app credential snapshot keyed by app name plus a separate `env` block for `CLIENT_ID` / `CLIENT_SECRET` / `XURL_BEARER_TOKEN` env-var presence. Every credential surface is reported as a boolean presence flag; no token material reaches the report.

active_app.description: App used when `--app NAME` is not supplied.

default_user.description: Username xurl picks when no `-u NAME` is supplied for this app.

oauth2_tokens.description: Per-user OAuth2 token presence map. Keys are usernames; values describe access/refresh token presence only.

commands.description: Per-command availability keyed by subcommand name.

reason.description: Human-readable reason a command is unavailable (e.g. "not authenticated").

accepted_schemes.description: Auth schemes the X API endpoint accepts. Populated from `xurl::api::auth_matrix::supported_auth` under embedded; empty under subprocess.

credentialed_schemes.description: Subset of `accepted_schemes` for which the active app has a stored credential.

reachable.description: True when `accepted_schemes` intersects `credentialed_schemes` and xurl is available. Single load-bearing bit agents key on.

cache.description: Entity-store health; null when no cache is configured.

linked_xurl_version.description: Version of the xurl crate linked into this bird build (embedded only). Omitted under subprocess.
